name: Moonshot
tagline: Digests two tech podcasts into briefs that sort the real from the loud
description: Watches for new episodes of a pair of technology shows and compresses each into a short briefing that separates what has substance from what is merely noisy. It puts the point in terms of your own situation and closes with a few moves worth making, so what lands is a decision aid rather than programme notes.
author: Luca280
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
